title: intent/.backup/db is empty -- no pre-incident store snapshot exists
body:
`intent/.backup/db/` is an empty directory. `intent doctor` has been reporting
"residue: intent/.backup/db -- backup-stale" and the residue was a real absence.

THE EVIDENCE IS TODAY: when intent#0070 emptied this project's 47 issues, the
first thing anyone reached for was a pre-incident snapshot of the store to
discriminate between two candidate writers. There was none. The attribution had
to be settled by building a repro in a throwaway project instead -- which worked,
and only because the mechanism happened to be reproducible.

A backup directory that exists, is advertised by doctor, and holds nothing is
worse than an absent one: it reads as coverage.
